intro.en: Content Understanding turns files into structured data. You choose or build an analyzer, send a file and read fields with confidence.
intro.ro: Content Understanding files ko structured data banata hai. Aap analyzer chunte ya banate hain, file bhejte hain aur confidence wali fields parhte hain.

text.en: Defines the kind of content, the fields and the models. Prebuilt ones exist for common cases.
text.ro: Content ki qism, fields aur models tay karta hai. Aam cases ke liye prebuilt analyzers hain.

text.en: Name, type, description and method of each field. Clear descriptions improve results.
text.ro: Har field ka naam, type, description aur method. Wazeh description nateeje behtar karti hai.

text.en: Value that is literally in the content (documents only).
text.ro: Woh value jo content mein lafz ba lafz maujood hai (sirf documents).

text.en: New text from the content, such as a summary.
text.ro: Content se naya text, jaise khulasa.

text.en: One value from a fixed list (enum).
For documents: how sure the service is, and where on the page the value was found.
text.ro: Documents mein: service ko kitna yaqeen hai, aur value page par kahan mili.

text.en: Documents, images, audio (transcript, speakers) and video (segments, key frames).
text.ro: Documents, images, audio (transcript, speakers) aur video (segments, key frames).

text.en: POST :analyze returns 202 and Operation-Location; GET that URL until Succeeded.
text.ro: POST :analyze 202 aur Operation-Location deta hai; Succeeded tak us URL par GET.

text.en: ContentUnderstandingClient, begin_analyze, result(), contents with markdown and fields.
text.ro: ContentUnderstandingClient, begin_analyze, result(), contents mein markdown aur fields.

text.en: The first call starts the analysis. The second one is repeated until the status is Succeeded.
text.ro: Pehli call analysis shuru karti hai. Doosri Succeeded tak dohrayi jati hai.

remember.ro: 202 ka matlab shuru hua, mukammal nahi.

remember.en: Change the description first when a field is weak.
remember.ro: Field kamzor ho to pehle description badlein.

remember.en: Test the analyzer on files that it has not seen.
remember.ro: Analyzer ko un files par test karein jo us ne nahi dekhin.

remember.en: One analyzer works for one kind of content; use a classifier to route mixed files.
remember.ro: Ek analyzer ek qism ke content ke liye hai; mili juli files classifier se baantein.

traps.en: High confidence is not proof; keep a check for important fields.
traps.ro: Zyada confidence saboot nahi; aham fields ki jaanch rakhein.

traps.en: generate fields can contain words that are not in the file; extract fields cannot.
traps.ro: generate fields mein aise alfaaz ho sakte hain jo file mein nahi; extract fields mein nahi.

traps.en: begin_analyze returns a poller and not the result; call result() first.
traps.ro: begin_analyze poller deta hai, nateeja nahi; pehle result() call karein.
